Estuary Boundaries for Mississippi Sound and Lake Borgne

Source: R/estuaryBoundaries_NCA.R
estuaryBoundaries_NCA.Rd

Polygon boundaries for subsets of the Mississippi Sound (including West Mississippi Sound and East Mississippi Sound) and Lake Borgne, extracted from the EPA EMAP-NCA US50 and Puerto Rico estuary boundaries dataset. These boundaries delineate bays and tributaries separately from the main, larger estuaries.

Usage

estuaryBoundaries_NCA

Format

A Simple feature collection with 39 features and 26 fields. Spatial geometries are in the USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic projection (ESRI: 102039, NAD83, meters). See the online documentation for more details; only key fields are described below.

WATERBODY

character, name of the waterbody within the estuarine system.

SYSTEM_NM

character, name of the estuarine system (e.g., "Mississippi Sound", "Lake Borgne").

geometry

MULTIPOLYGON of the estuary boundary features.

Source

Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Environmental Monitoring and Assessment Program - National Coastal Assessment (EMAP-NCA), as downloaded from ArcGIS Online at https://www.arcgis.com/apps/mapviewer/index.html?layers=1c64d9f81b904abcaf8ab2cf5767b71f.

Details

The raw zipped shapefile US50_PR_Estuaries.zip was stored in data-raw/EMAP-NCA_EstuaryBoundaries/ and filtered for entries where SYSTEM_NM contains "Mississippi Sound" or "Lake Borgne". The data-raw processing scripts are available in the package repository at: https://github.com/CMEP-MS/msepBoundaries.
